comment: Curated, community-editable knowledge base injected into Stage 2: best-practice OSS libraries by domain, plus the language selection matrix (technical fit only - language familiarity is never an input; an explicit user preference overrides the matrix and is flagged). Versions are minimums known-good at last edit.

language_selection_matrix.constraints: Single binary + low latency + no ML
Single binary + fast ship + simple logic

web_api.name: FastAPI
web_api.use_for: HTTP APIs with validation and OpenAPI for free

web_api.name: axum
web_api.use_for: HTTP APIs on tokio with tower middleware

persistence.name: SQLite
persistence.use_for: single-node relational storage; the default until proven otherwise

persistence.name: PostgreSQL
persistence.use_for: relational storage with concurrent writers or growth headroom

persistence.name: sqlx
persistence.use_for: compile-time checked SQL without an ORM

persistence.name: SQLAlchemy
persistence.use_for: SQL toolkit when queries outgrow raw strings

auth.name: Authlib
auth.use_for: OAuth/OIDC flows instead of hand-rolled token code

auth.name: Lucia-style session pattern + argon2
auth.use_for: simple session auth; never hand-roll password hashing (use argon2/bcrypt libs)

background_jobs.name: APScheduler
background_jobs.use_for: in-process scheduled jobs without a queue server

files_media.name: Pillow
files_media.use_for: image resize/thumbnail instead of shelling to ImageMagick

frontend.name: htmx
frontend.use_for: interactivity without an SPA build chain

frontend.name: SvelteKit
frontend.use_for: full app framework when an SPA is genuinely warranted

frontend.name: Chart.js
frontend.use_for: dashboard charts instead of hand-drawn canvas

integrations.name: gspread
integrations.use_for: Google Sheets read/write with a service account

integrations.name: httpx
integrations.use_for: HTTP client with timeouts and async support
